svg.title: Q, Qwynn Marcelle
svg.desc:
The personal mark: an amber Q on the page's own charcoal.
Not the Marcelle Labs logo, which belongs to a company rather than to a person, and nothing borrowed from the organisation this application is addressed to.
Three constraints shaped it. It carries its own ground, so it reads the same against light and dark browser chrome rather than dissolving into one of them. The ring is heavy (4 units of a 32 unit box, so 2px at 16px) because a hairline monogram is a grey smudge in a tab strip. And the tail is a straight rule rather than a calligraphic stroke: the rule is this design's structural mark, and at 16px a diagonal that thin is the first thing to disappear.
Colours are the token values, not approximations. Charcoal 1a1a17 is the ink step; amber d9a84e is the lens accent, the one saturated mark the surface spends.
